LicenseKey.title: LicenseKey
LicenseKey.description: Universal software license key or user/pass credential with time duration and remote pause/stop/delete controls.

key.description: Unique secret license key or identifier

durationLabel.description: Duration label: 1 Hour, 1 Day, 10 Days, 15 Days, 30 Days, Permanent

durationSeconds.description: Duration in seconds or -1 for permanent

label.description: Customer name, device tag, or admin note

expiresAt.description: ISO timestamp of expiration or null for permanent

pausedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the key was paused

/license_keys/{keyId}.description: Collection of remote-controllable license keys and user/password accounts
